title: User Registration and Login
description: Verify that users can register and log in successfully using Supabase Auth with valid credentials, and that session persistence and JWT token refresh function correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to the splash screen and proceed to registration page.
Complete registration form with valid data.
Submit registration and verify success message.
Log out and navigate to login page.
Log in using registered credentials.
Verify user is authenticated and redirected to the main feed.
Remain idle beyond 30 minutes (or configured timeout) and verify session expiration.
Verify JWT token auto-refresh maintains session without requiring login.
Log out and verify session is cleared.

title: Password Recovery Flow
description: Verify that users can request password recovery and update their password successfully using the password recovery feature.

steps.description: Navigate to login page and click on 'Forgot Password'.
Submit registered email to receive recovery instructions.
Verify that recovery email is sent.
Follow recovery link and update password with a valid new password.
Verify password update confirmation.
Attempt login with new password.
Verify login is successful.

title: Post Creation with Rich Media and Features
description: Validate that posts can be created with text (within plan character limits), images, videos, audios, mentions, tags, polls, and evidence boards, and that posts are correctly published to the user feed.

steps.description: Login as a Premium user.
Navigate to post creation page.
Input text exceeding Free plan limit but within Premium limit (e.g., 20000 characters).
Upload multiple images, videos, and audio files.
Add @mentions and multiple tags.
Add a poll with multiple options and duration.
Add several evidence items including text notes, images, videos, and links.
Associate post with a thematic community the user belongs to.
Publish the post.
Verify post appears in the feed with all multimedia content and interactive elements.
Verify poll allows voting in real time.

title: Post Creation Text Limit Enforcement per Plan
description: Ensure that text length limits for posts are enforced according to the user's subscription plan: Free (280), Basic (1000), Pro (5000), Premium (25000 characters).

steps.description: For each subscription plan (Free, Basic, Pro, Premium), login as a user with that plan.
Attempt to create a post exceeding the maximum allowed text length by one character.
Verify that the system prevents the post creation and shows an appropriate validation error.
Create a post with text exactly at the character limit.
Verify that the post is accepted and published successfully.

title: Post Interaction: Likes, Comments, Nested Comments, Saves, Shares
description: Verify users can like posts, add nested comments, save posts to personal collection, and share posts via direct messages, with real-time updates visible to relevant users.

steps.description: Login as User A and navigate to a post.
Like the post.
Verify like count increments and UI updates.
Add a comment to the post.
Add a nested reply to the comment.
Verify comments appear in correct nested order.
Save the post.
Verify post appears in saved posts page for User A.
Share the post via direct message to User B.
Verify User B receives the shared post in messages.

title: Community Join with Subscription Plan Restrictions
description: Validate that users can only join thematic communities they have access to based on their subscription plan, and that access is denied or gated as appropriate.

steps.description: Login as Free plan user.
Attempt to join a Pro+ or Premium community.
Verify join is denied with appropriate message.
Attempt to join a Basic+ community.
Verify join is allowed if the plan permits.
Login as Premium user and join communities of all tiers.
Verify user can join all communities.

title: Real-Time Direct Messaging Functionality
description: Verify that users can send and receive real-time messages, view conversation lists, mark messages as read, delete conversations, and see message unread counts update correctly.

steps.description: Login as User A and User B in separate sessions/devices.
User A sends a message to User B.
Verify User B receives the message in real time.
User B marks the message as read.
Verify unread message counter decreases accordingly.
User A deletes the conversation.
Verify conversation is removed from User A's interface but remains for User B.

title: Notification System Real-Time Alerts and Preferences
description: Validate notifications are generated for likes, comments, new followers, messages, and mentions, are delivered in real time, can be marked as read, cleared, and respect user notification preferences.

steps.description: Login as User A and User B on separate sessions.
User B likes a post by User A.
Verify User A receives like notification immediately.
User B comments on User A's post.
Verify User A receives comment notification.
User B follows User A.
Verify User A receives new follower notification.
User B sends mention in a comment to User A.
Verify User A receives mention notification.
User A updates notification preferences to mute comment notifications.
User B comments again on User A's post.
Verify User A does not receive comment notification.

title: Global Search with Filters and Trending Topics
description: Verify that the global search returns accurate and filtered results across posts, users, communities, and tags, and that trending topics are displayed and accessible.

steps.description: Navigate to the search page.
Execute search query with common keywords.
Verify results include matching posts, users, communities, and tags.
Apply filters to restrict search results to posts only.
Verify results contain only posts.
Navigate to trending topics.
Verify display of current trending topics with appropriate metadata.
Select a trending topic to view related posts.
Verify posts are relevant to the selected trending topic.

title: Document Library Access Control and Upload
description: Verify document upload, management, and access controls in the document library, ensuring only Pro and Premium subscribers can upload and access restricted documents.

steps.description: Login as Free plan user and navigate to document library.
Verify upload option is disabled or hidden.
Attempt to access a Pro/Premium restricted document.
Verify access is denied with subscription prompt.
Login as Pro plan user.
Upload a PDF document.
Verify document appears in library with correct metadata.
Download the uploaded document.
Verify successful download and view statistics update.

title: Moderation Queue and Actions
description: Verify that reported content is added to a prioritized moderation queue, that moderators can take actions (approve, remove, ban), and users can submit appeals which are handled correctly.

steps.description: Login as a regular user and report a post with a specific report type.
Verify report entry appears in moderation queue with correct priority score.
Login as moderator and review the report in queue.
Perform moderation action to remove the reported post.
Verify post is removed from public feeds and user is notified.
User submits an appeal for the removed post.
Verify appeal appears in appeals queue and moderator can approve or deny appeal.

title: Subscription Plan Upgrade and Billing Cycle Management
description: Ensure users can upgrade or change their subscription plans using Stripe checkout with monthly and annual billing cycles, including free trials and discounts, and that plan features are correctly enabled post-upgrade.

steps.description: Login as Free user and navigate to subscription management page.
Select Basic plan with monthly billing.
Complete Stripe checkout process successfully.
Verify user's plan is updated and new features unlocked.
Switch to Pro plan with annual billing using a discount coupon.
Verify discount is applied and billing cycle is annual.
Cancel Pro plan subscription.
Verify subscription is cancelled and access reverts after billing period.

title: UI Responsiveness and Accessibility Compliance
description: Verify that the UI adapts correctly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices in both light and dark modes, and meets accessibility standards including keyboard navigation and readable contrast.

steps.description: Open the application on desktop, tablet-sized, and mobile-sized viewports.
Verify layout and components adapt responsively and maintain usability.
Toggle between light and dark UI themes.
Verify colors and contrasts meet accessibility guidelines.
Navigate all interactive components using keyboard only.
Verify full keyboard accessibility without visual or functional issues.

title: AI Theory Analysis Feature
description: Validate that the AI-generated theory analysis displays key points, identifies logical fallacies, suggests counterarguments, and lists related topics with simulated delay and mock data.

steps.description: Open a post and invoke the AI theory analysis modal.
Verify display of key analysis points after expected delay.
Verify presentation of identified logical fallacies.
Verify counterarguments are listed.
Verify related topics are shown with navigation options.

title: API Input Validation and Security Checks
description: Verify all API endpoints validate inputs properly, sanitize data to prevent security vulnerabilities like injection attacks, and return appropriate error responses on invalid or malicious inputs.

steps.description: Attempt to submit posts, comments, and profile updates with inputs containing SQL injection patterns, script tags, or malformed data.
Verify APIs reject bad inputs and return descriptive error messages without performing harmful operations.
Perform penetration tests on authentication and subscription APIs.
Confirm that authentication tokens cannot be forged and subscription changes require valid Stripe confirmation.
